key_phrases: low to mid-single-digit revenue growth guidance
analysis.reasoning: The company reported strong top and bottom-line growth, with Services hitting an all-time high. However, the sentiment is tempered by significant uncertainty regarding tariffs (estimated $900M cost hit) and macroeconomic volatility. Management showed high confidence in product innovation (AI/Apple Intelligence) and supply chain diversification but was notably cautious and evasive when asked to predict tariff impacts or China's long-term trajectory beyond the current quarter. Quantitative specificity was very high, with detailed revenue breakdowns by product line provided.
